run_upload_gmock: run upload_gmock.py to upload a Google Mock patch for review with default cc list
run_upload_gmock_cc: run upload_gmock.py with --cc flag to specify additional reviewers for the patch
run_upload_gmock_auto_cc: run upload_gmock.py to auto-add googlemock@googlegroups.com to the cc list if not present
run_upload_gmock_preserve: run upload_gmock.py to pass all upload.py flags through while appending the gmock group cc
run_upload_gmock_exec: run upload_gmock.py to invoke upload.py via os.execv with modified command line arguments
